name: Glasgow

neighborhoods.name: West End
neighborhoods.homes: red and blond sandstone tenement flats

housing: Glasgow's rentals are dominated by sandstone tenement flats, with modern apartment blocks in the city centre and by the Clyde.

localRules.text: All private landlords in Scotland must register with the council for the area where they rent out a home.

In Scotland the landlord must lodge the deposit with an approved scheme (SafeDeposits Scotland, Letting Protection Service Scotland or MyDeposits Scotland) within 30 working days of the tenancy starting.

climate: Glasgow is mild and very wet, so photograph any damp, mould or condensation and check window seals and the heating.
fact: Most Glasgow renters live in tenement flats with a shared close, so note the stair, back court and door entry system at move-in.
